title: All-Japan-Grid: an OSM-derived, externally validated model of Japan's transmission network
description: Geographic and electrical model of Japan's 10 regional transmission networks built from OpenStreetMap, with provenance-tracked curation in a unified database, CIM/CGMES Level-1/2 exports, AC/DC power-flow cases for all regions, versioned numeric Ybus matrices (.mat/.npz), and external validation against utility disclosures (per-line flow measurements, official line lists). Model interventions (connection, value, and allocation edits) are registered in a public ledger (docs/MODEL_INTERVENTIONS.md) with rationale, instrumentation, and opt-out flags. Code is MIT licensed; OSM-derived data is ODbL-1.0 (attribution: OpenStreetMap contributors).
